rules.verified_with: Messages messages.android_20240528_00_RC01 on an Android 15 emulator, 2026-11-08. The Send button reports no tap event; the compose field clearing in one change is the signal.

Instagram 455.0.0.51.72 on a Pixel 7a with Android 17, 2026-11-14, through a rule taught there with this package, event and view id. The Send button reports no tap and the field no text change; the field found empty at a selection change is the signal, so this needs 0.5.1 or later.

Telegram 13.2.2 on a Galaxy A16 5G and a moto g play (Android 16, English), 2026-11-15: each message cell spans the screen and its text ends with "Received at <time>" for a received message, so the side of the screen cannot tell.

Telegram 13.2.2 on a Galaxy A16 5G and a moto g play (Android 16, English), 2026-11-15: a send reports no field clear, and its message cell ends with "Sent at <time>", then ", Not seen" or ", Seen", which changes in place once it is read; the label is keyed on the text up to the time, so one send is labelled once.

Zangi 6.6.4 on a Galaxy A16 5G and a moto g play (Android 16, English), 2026-11-15: each send clears the message box in one change (5 of 5 per phone). Zangi exposes no message text in the chat to accessibility, so the clear is the only sign of a send.

Zangi 6.6.4 on a Galaxy A16 5G and a moto g play (Android 16, English), 2026-11-15: with the chat closed, a received message posts a notification with no category, the sender as title and the message as text. Zangi keeps one notification per chat and updates it; the Galaxy reported 5 of 5 updates, the moto 3 of 5. Only message notifications were seen; Zangi call notifications were not tried.
